tiles.name: Police Station
tiles.neighborText: Neighbors can't be targeted by Opportunity cards or Hostile Takeover.
tiles.landingText: Pay a $25 parking ticket to the bank.

tiles.name: Fire Station
tiles.neighborText: Neighbors are safe from the Fire! Event.

tiles.name: City Hall
tiles.landingText: Pay $10 per building level you own, then start an Emergency Council session with you setting the agenda.

tiles.name: Power Plant
tiles.neighborText: Neighbor rent is -25%, and building there costs 50% less.
tiles.landingText: Pay $50 to the player who owns both utilities, or to the bank if nobody does.

tiles.name: Transit Hub
tiles.neighborText: When you land on a neighbor owned by someone else, you may pay $25 and hop onto the Transit Hub instead of paying rent.
tiles.landingText: You may pay $50 to move to any railroad.

tiles.name: Landfill
tiles.landingText: Pay a $25 cleanup fee to the bank.
